title: Silver Jubilee Celebrations - 17th & 18th November 2012
location: Nagarjuna Vidyashramamu, Hill Colony, Nagarjuna Sagar
description: With the success of SMRUTHI the enthusiasm and confidence among the NAAVAAites has grown enormously to conduct the silver jubilee celebrations on the occasion of completion of 25 years from the inception of the school. With long term determination of the NAAVAA board members and few consistent supporters among the members of NAAVAA and with a painstaking efforts combined with structured planning and execution the most awaited silver jubilee celebrations was held in a festive mood.

title: SMRUTHI-Dwi Dashabdi Utsav - Dec 16th 2007
location: Nagarjuna Vidyashramamu, Hill Colony, Nagarjuna Sagar
description: The SMRUTHI-Dwi Dashabdi Utsav was held in a grand ceremonious way on December 16th, 2007 in the school premises with the participation of all the current students, nearly 500 old students and approximately 200 current and ex-teaching and non-teaching staff.
